title: The Evergreen and Pink Christmas Bathroom
description: A Christmas bathroom from Walmart: a pink snow-flocked ceramic Christmas tree, a trees-and-gifts shower curtain, a green tree bath rug set, Wintery Tree bath towels and a Christmas tree soap dispenser.
intro: Every December the whole house gets decorated and the guest bathroom gets a sad candle. That's the one room every single holiday guest walks into, so it's getting the glow-up this year. Deep evergreen rugs and towels with little white trees, a shower curtain covered in trees and wrapped gifts, a tree soap pump by the sink, and the star of the show: a pink flocked ceramic tree with the old-school colored bulbs, like the one your grandma had, except pink. Five swaps and the whole room says Christmas.

sections.heading: The big swaps
paragraphs: The Inosoo 72 by 72 inch fabric Christmas shower curtain in Trees and Gifts, the Better Homes and Gardens cotton Holiday Trees 2 piece bath rug set in green (17 by 24 and 20 by 30 inches), and the Better Homes and Gardens Signature Soft holiday bath towel 2 pack in Wintery Tree.

sections.heading: The little touches
paragraphs: The 12 inch hand painted ceramic Christmas tree in Pink Snow Flocked with its colored bulbs and star toppers, and the printed Christmas tree ceramic soap dispenser.

sections.heading: What is real and what is styling
paragraphs: The products are the pieces linked here. The bathroom, the tub and everything else in the photos are styling extras.
Photos are AI-generated styling ideas, so check each listing for the exact item, color and size before you buy.
